lesson.concept: When you substitute k = 2^x and solve, you may get values of k that are impossible. 2^x is always positive. Reject any k that is zero or negative.
lesson.why: This is one of the highest-frequency errors DBE reported for this section.

work: Both k values are positive, so both are valid here. If k had been negative, reject it.
